0.1.0 PREVIEW

Keep your work.
Know what changes.

Keep your Claude Code environment and work in order.

Lintel is a focused personal tool for Claude Code. Adjust settings, preserve instructions and sessions, and prepare your next stretch of work: see the scope and changes first, then approve execution. Use the macOS App or standalone CLI, and manage environments on selected hosts over SSH. Nothing uploads by default.

CAPABILITIES / SIX WAYS TO BEGIN

From environment settings
to your next stretch of work.

Six ways in, for six real kinds of task.
Know the scope and changes, on your machine or a selected host.

A source development preview. Formal distribution and verification in real environments are still in progress.

Follow an operation through to its result ↓

Six illustrative scenes · No computer access or execution

01 CONFIGURATION

Adjust outbound settings ↗

Choose “Keep features”, “Reduce outbound requests”, or customize each setting. Review current settings, sources and the exact diff, approve the write, then read it back to check.

Configuration readback and actual runtime effects are checked separately. The local proxy covers only connections routed through it.

02 PORTABLE WORK

Take your work with you ↗

Select specific original instructions, memories and sessions to create an encrypted work package. Read it independently of the original task and prepare a handoff. Import has its own preview and approval.

Original bytes are preserved; credentials are not copied. Reading materials does not establish verified native session continuation.

03 A FRESH ENVIRONMENT

Put an old environment in order ↗

Choose the exact scope for local sign-in repair, cleanup and rebuilding, or retirement. Preserve work first, then handle identified local state in the approved order.

Official logout has separate conditions. Handling local files does not revoke a server-side account.

04 BROWSER COMPANION

Care for browser data ↗

Load the companion extension in a selected profile, pair the local connection, and manage a finite set of site rules. Cleanup first isolates data in preparation; confirm deletion again after a full browser restart.

The extension still requires development loading. Production browser use remains unverified; deleted data cannot be restored.

05 ACROSS SSH

Manage SSH hosts ↗

Connect through an existing SSH alias. The target host’s runner executes the same environment tasks. After disconnection or reopening the App, check results using the original task ID.

Production VPS use needs independent verification. Execution after a host reboot is not promised.

06 RECEIPTS & RECOVERY

Check results and restore ↗

Inspect the original task’s completed steps, errors and unresolved checks. Restore configuration by field; service restoration has a separate preview. Later edits are checked and preserved.

Restoration also needs approval. Some operations cannot be undone, and deletion has no universal recovery.

ONE CORE / CLEAR BOUNDARIES

Control it here. Execute on the selected host.

macOS App
Choose an environment, review changes, approve plans and read receipts on your desktop.
Standalone CLI
Shares the execution core with the App. Planning, approval, execution and queries follow the same rules.
Linux / SSH
The target host’s runner executes the task. Materials and task records stay on that host; ciphertext transfer is a separate action.

The browser extension and local connection are separate, finite entry points. This website presents the product; it does not access your environment or execute these operations.

PREVIEW NOTE

Source development preview: no formal Release or signed/notarized download is available yet. Real authentication, native session continuation, production browser use and production remote hosts still have unverified items. Browsers and proxies have distinct limits: changing configuration does not block all traffic, and rebuilding a local environment does not change a server-side account. General reuse licensing for original materials remains undecided.

This website presents the product and does not connect to the execution core. No default uploads, accounts or trackers; the theme and game best score stay on this device.
